findings.what: Mp3Player.VCC connects directly to net.VBAT with no switch, enable or load gate
findings.consequence: A DFR0534-class module idles at an estimated 15-25 mA. Against everything else on the board asleep (~0.4 mA) that is roughly 40x, and it turns the stated one-month requirement into about 2-3 days on a 1000 mAh cell. The deep-sleep design that shaped the whole pin map buys almost nothing while this part is unswitched.

resolution.reason: needs the module's real idle current

findings.what: CurrentShunt is 0.33R in an 0805, in the motor driver's ground return
findings.consequence: A standard 0805 is rated 0.125 W, which caps it at about 0.61 A continuous. If the lid motor stalls above that the shunt is over its rating before the driver is, and it fails open in the driver's ground return.
